newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in evening.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady on Thursday in thin trade with people waiting on the sidelines ahead of the release of the U.S. payroll numbers tomorrow, dealers said.
"The market is still quiet as most traders are waiting for the release of Friday's U.S payroll employment numbers," a local dealer said.
The jobless claims was forecast to reach around 320,000 compared with 322,000 reported in the previous report.
Day-to-day, weekend and week-fixed slipped 1/16 percentage point to a common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent respectively.

Among term rates, one month was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent, nine-months remained steady at 6-1/16 5-15/16 and twelve-months was steady at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
